about: The Local AI shelf (roadmap step 14). A copy ships with the add-on; a newer one is read from the public releases repository (local-ai/models.json) once a day while the app's checks are allowed. Sizes from Ollama's registry, licences from each maker's Hugging Face page, checked 2026-11-18. Keep it small: the basic model, a few good ones per card size, the search model; anything else comes in through Other model.
